messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: apigw-prod reporting 502/504 surge — error rate 13% over baseline for the last 3m. Alert group: apigw-edge-errors.
maya.sre: I'm on it, attaching to voice. Observing spike concentrated on eu-west-1 edge pool.
alex.gateway: Confirmed — edge nodes f10-f14 showing large connection resets to upstream (timeout + 502). Latency on upstream jump from 45ms -> 250ms.
dave.eng: any recent deploys to apigw or mux? I don't see deploys in last 2h.
maya.sre: no deploys. Node metrics show connection backlog rising (accept queue). Could be upstream service overload or proxy thread exhaustion.
oncall-night: I'm the on-call lead. I'll take coordination. First priority: contain customer impact, enable fast fallback routing.
maya.sre: Action 1: enable proxy-level circuit breaker for apigw routes to chat-service variant A (high fanout). Running command: 
```
rbctl route modify apigw --circuit-breaker 20% --action failover:chat-service-b
```
Apply now?
support-lead: do it — support already seeing repeat errors for /v1/chat. Customers on EU region flagged dashboard.
alex.gateway: applying circuit-breaker now, pushing to edge pool.
(1m) alex.gateway: pushed. Traffic shift starting, monitoring.
maya.sre: Action 2: rotate proxy workers on f10-f14 to flush stuck connections. Will drain and restart one-by-one to avoid full pool bounce.
dave.eng: I'll help — restarting worker on f10. Command: `systemctl restart redwood-proxy@worker-3`
(2m) dave.eng: restarted f10 worker, connection resets decreased on that box.
oncall-night: good, confirm impact on user-facing error rate.
incident-bot: Telemetry: system-error-rate now 7% (down from 13%), 95th latency for apigw down to 120ms.
maya.sre: still seeing a smaller tail from TLS handshake resets on some upstreams. Hypothesis: upstream keepalives exhaustion after burst (many short-lived connections).
dave.eng: temporary mitigation: enable long-lived keepalive and increase upstream connection pool for chat-service-b. Pushing quick config: `upstream.max_connections=500`
alex.gateway: updated upstream pool on cluster eu-west-1, restarting worker f11 only.
(8m) alex.gateway: after pool increase + rotating workers, error rate ~3.1% and customer errors trending down.
support-lead: telling CS to update customers on status: "Partial degradation in EU, most traffic restored; followup postmortem coming."
oncall-night: creating incident ticket INC-2026-004, assigning postmortem to maya.sre.
maya.sre: notes for postmortem: timeline, root cause hypothesis (upstream connection pool exhaustion + proxy worker exhaustion), mitigation sequence (circuit-breaker -> rotate workers -> increase pool), metrics before/after, recommended permanent fixes (connection pooling defaults, upstream backpressure, automated worker restart on accept-queue thresholds).
dave.eng: runbook add: automated traffic-shift recipe when edge error rate >10% for 3m.
support-lead: escalate to ops leads if any customers still impacted after 30m.
(25m) incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Paging resolved.
oncall-night: handing off to oncall-night for monitoring window; will stay reachable for 20m.
oncall-night: final checks: set statuspage to "partial outage (EU) — mitigated, monitoring" and include link to INC-2026-004.
support-lead: done.
maya.sre: I'll own postmortem and send summary to #postmortems in 48h.
dave.eng: thumbs. :thumbsup:
(30m) incident-bot: thread archived: last action recorded.
